title: Say hello
brief:
Make the computer say hello. Write a program that prints exactly this line:

```
Hello, world!
```

Check the capital H, the comma and the exclamation mark.

vocabulary.gloss: a function that shows text on the screen
what the program shows when it runs

starterCode: # Write your code below this line

tests.name: uses a capital H and an exclamation mark

hints: Use print(). Put the text inside the round brackets, and put quotes around the text.
The text must be exactly Hello, world! — a capital H, then a comma, a space, and an exclamation mark at the end.
The whole program is one line: print("Hello, world!")
